invalid_certs.title: mTLS Certificates Missing or Invalid
invalid_certs.description:
The client certificates required to authenticate with the REWE API are missing or invalid.

Please place your 'client.pem' and 'client.key' in the 'custom_components/rewe/certs/' directory to proceed.

For instructions on how to extract these certificates from the REWE app, see the README at {readme_url}.

login.title: REWE Account & Loyalty Card Setup
login.description:
### 💳 REWE Bonus / Customer Account

- **Barcode / Card Number**: Enter your REWE Bonus card number to display a live QR code for scanning at checkout.
- **Account Session Token**: Enter your `rstp` session cookie value (starts with `ey...`) from www.rewe.de (F12 > Application > Cookies).

📖 For detailed instructions, see the REWE Integration Documentation on GitHub.
